name: FlowScrape v3
description: Production-grade web automation and data extraction with proxy rotation, form filling, and ethical safeguards.
_comment_permissions: Every entry here must have a caller. Dropped in the C-08 trim: activeTab (redundant beside <all_urls> host access), declarativeNetRequest and webRequest (zero uses), notifications (zero uses; the notification providers the README advertises do not exist).
_comment_content_scripts: page-sniffer.js is NOT declared here. It wraps fetch/XHR in the page's own world and forwards request and response bodies, so it is registered at runtime via chrome.scripting only while an API_SNIFFER run is active, scoped to that run's origin. See _enableSniffer in background/service-worker.js.
_comment_web_accessible_resources: Only modules a content script dynamically imports belong here; anything listed is readable by every page and can be probed to fingerprint the extension. This is the transitive closure of the two import(chrome.runtime.getURL(...)) calls in content/injector.js.
